question: H, I, J, K, L, and M are six people sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table for a group discussion. H is seated second to the right of J. solution: Given: H, I, J, K, L, and M are six people sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table for a group discussion. 1) H is seated second to the right of J. 2) L is seated third to the left of H.
